## What is left (the lead's)

- Run the whole gate (`npm run verify`) once; this note's session was not allowed to.
- Land the lane; then the release itself, in a session the founder starts, away from a game. The host's own build (`build-site.mjs`) has not been run on the new libraries: the release page makes it the first check.
- Whether the pilot is still wanted at all (retire after the tracker's move, T-15) is the founder's question.

## What the founder does with their own hands, in order

1. Pick a time with no game in the next 24 hours and tell the lead.
2. Start the session in the Claude app where the pilot is published (Sites access).
3. Say yes when the lead asks to publish (only after the lead's checks passed).
4. On a phone: the scorer opens and says "Saved to shared database", last season's games look the same, a practice basket shows in a second browser.
5. If anything looks wrong, say "go back"; the old version returns in minutes, saved games untouched.
